text: Dr. Hess Green, a wealthy anthropologist studying the Myrthians, an ancient African nation of blood drinkers, is [stabbed with a ceremonial dagger|trigger|a sudden accident or attack] by his unstable assistant in his mansion full of African art. He survives with immortality and [a need for fresh blood|threat|blood drinkers]. When the assistant's estranged wife Ganja arrives, the two become lovers, and she finds [her husband's corpse frozen in the wine cellar|images|corpses and body parts] before she [agrees to marry her host|who_suffers|spouses and lovers].
